zh-Hant.title: 降生與童年
zh-Hant.intro: 從天使報喜到逃往埃及，跟隨耶穌降生的最初幾幕。
zh-Hant.outro: 道成了肉身，住在我們中間。

en.title: Birth & Childhood
en.intro: From the annunciation to the flight into Egypt, the first scenes of Jesus' birth.
en.outro: The Word became flesh and dwelt among us.

hints: 畫面中有一位帶翅膀的使者。
領受信息的那位女子來自拿撒勒。
這是耶穌降生前的序幕。
zh-Hant.summary: 天使加百列向童女馬利亞顯現，宣告她將懷孕生子，這孩子要稱為至高者的兒子。
zh-Hant.artNote: Gerard David 以對稱構圖與柔和光線描繪天使與馬利亞，紅色床榻與書本象徵她的禱告生活。

verseHints.text: 馬利亞說：「我是主的使女，情願照你的話成就在我身上。」天使就離開她去了。

keyVerse.text: 你要懷孕生子，可以給他起名叫耶穌。

zh-Hant.geoNote: 傳統認為報喜地點在拿撒勒；今為以色列北部城市，天使報喜教堂所在。

hints: 畫面中央是一個被布包裹的嬰孩。
母親身旁有馬槽與牲畜。
zh-Hant.summary: 馬利亞在伯利恆生下耶穌，放在馬槽裡；天使向野地的牧羊人報大喜的信息。
zh-Hant.artNote: Cranach 以深色背景襯托聖嬰與天使，強調道成肉身的謙卑。

verseHints.text: 就生了頭胎的兒子，用布包起來，放在馬槽裡，因為客店裡沒有地方。

keyVerse.text: 因今天在大衛的城裡，為你們生了救主，就是主基督。

zh-Hant.geoNote: 伯利恆位於耶路撒冷以南約 10 公里；聖誕教堂是傳統上的耶穌降生地。

hints: 約瑟在夜間帶著一家人趕路。
他們要躲避希律王的殺害。
天使吩咐他們往埃及去。
zh-Hant.summary: 天使警告約瑟，約瑟就連夜帶著馬利亞和耶穌逃往埃及，躲避希律的屠殺。
zh-Hant.artNote: Caravaggio 以夜色與休息中的聖家，將逃亡的疲憊與天使的守護並置。

verseHints.text: 他們去後，有主的使者向約瑟夢中顯現，說：「起來！帶著小孩子同他母親逃往埃及，住在那裡，等我吩咐你；因為希律必尋找小孩子，要除滅他。」

keyVerse.text: 住在那裡，直到希律死了。這是要應驗主藉先知所說的話，說：「我從埃及召出我的兒子來。」

zh-Hant.geoNote: 聖經未指明埃及的具體城市；傳統上常與尼羅河三角洲或開羅一帶聯繫。

hints: An angel with wings appears in the scene.
The woman receiving the message is from Nazareth.
This is the prelude to Jesus' birth.
en.summary: The angel Gabriel appears to the virgin Mary and announces that she will bear a son, the Son of the Most High.
en.artNote: Gerard David builds the scene on symmetry and soft light; the red bed and open book suggest Mary's life of prayer.

verseHints.text: Mary said, “Behold, the handmaid of the Lord; be it to me according to your word.” The angel departed from her.

keyVerse.text: Behold, you will conceive in your womb, and give birth to a son, and will call his name ‘Jesus.’

en.geoNote: Tradition places the Annunciation in Nazareth, now a city in northern Israel; the Basilica of the Annunciation stands there.

hints: A newborn wrapped in cloth lies at the center.
The mother is beside a manger, with animals nearby.
en.summary: Mary gives birth to Jesus in Bethlehem and lays him in a manger; angels announce the good news to shepherds.
en.artNote: Cranach sets the child and angels against deep shadow, stressing the humility of the incarnation.

verseHints.text: She gave birth to her firstborn son. She wrapped him in bands of cloth, and laid him in a feeding trough, because there was no room for them in the inn.

keyVerse.text: For there is born to you, this day, in the city of David, a Savior, who is Christ the Lord.

en.geoNote: Bethlehem lies about 10 km south of Jerusalem; the Church of the Nativity is the traditional site of Jesus' birth.

hints: Joseph leads the family on a night journey.
They are fleeing King Herod's violence.
An angel tells them to go to Egypt.

image.title: Rest on the Flight into Egypt

en.summary: Warned by an angel, Joseph takes Mary and Jesus by night and flees to Egypt to escape Herod's slaughter.
en.artNote: Caravaggio contrasts the weariness of the fleeing family with the angel's quiet protection in the night.

verseHints.text: Now when they had departed, behold, an angel of the Lord appeared to Joseph in a dream, saying, “Arise and take the young child and his mother, and flee into Egypt, and stay there until I tell you, for Herod will seek the young child to destroy him.”

keyVerse.text: and was there until the death of Herod; that it might be fulfilled which was spoken by the Lord through the prophet, saying, “Out of Egypt I called my son.”

en.geoNote: Scripture does not name a city in Egypt; tradition often connects the flight with the Nile Delta or the Cairo area.
